source.name: Warcraft Forever public professions data
source.verifiedBy: Verified Forever esES SDK names, Wowhead ID-matched ES/EN recipe and item tooltips; only documented and source-verifiable locale mappings.

coverage.matchMethod: Same profession, product item, output count and complete reagent IDs/quantities

updates.verification: nameLocale=esES from Warcraft Forever latest item records
Wowhead Spanish recipe/product labels and recipe reagents matched against full auctionhouse.tk.gg manufacturing signatures
updates.caveat: Classic SoD vs Forever; exact catalogue signatures; does not verify in-game availability

updates.verification: Wowhead Forever Spanish spell labels and direct ingredient+product comparisons, validated against live recipe catalogue by profession/item/output quantity/reagent IDs and counts
updates.caveat: Wowhead Forever page contains 'Este hechizo no existe en el juego' note; verified catalogue records and Spanish labels do not establish in-game recipe availability.

updates.verification: Wowhead Spanish translated crafting-spell names and recipe ingredients matched by recipe profession, item output, quantity, and full reagent identities and counts against auctionhouse.tk.gg. Mixed Forever ES, Classic ES, Classic PTR ES provenance; game availability unverified.
updates.caveat: Do not infer that client learned or can craft these recipes; ID sets differ between market and Wowhead.

updates.verification: Independent Wowhead Classic Spanish/English public tooltip queries (locale=6/0) with Spanish name != English and exact market recipe English name, product item ID, output quantity, and complete reagent item IDs and quantities; 25 of 29 candidates selected, 27 confirmed, 2 rejected.
updates.caveat: Wowhead Classic's recipe translations are matched to market crafting signatures; this does not establish that these recipes can be learned in WoW Forever.

updates.verification: Two independent localized Wowhead Classic tooltip responses (Spanish locale 6 and English locale 0), with exact English recipe name and crafting identity: profession/product item ID/output quantity/complete reagent IDs and quantities. 45 discovered in general ranges and 5 additional in special crafting ranges.
updates.caveat: Wowhead crafting records do not confirm this recipe can be learned or crafted in user's Forever game.

updates.verification: Wowhead Spanish + English tooltip queries on Classic/Forever; exact crafted product and full reagent identities. For Jar of Nightmarish Mojo, Forever's new Spanish/English label plus Classic's full ingredient/output signature for same spell. Multi-output quantities from market corroborated by independent Forever recipe pages.
updates.caveat: Translations cover all 920 market catalog recipes; this does not establish availability of any recipe in user's live WoW client or translation of all items.

updates.verification: Each item ID fetched independently from Wowhead Spanish and English item tooltips; enUS must match live market catalog name and esES must be non-placeholder and different from enUS; 12 ingredients, 11 alchemy products, 29 other products.
updates.caveat: WoW Classic SoD translated names used when Forever tooltip records unavailable; names are matched to exact market item IDs, not proof of client learnability or availability.

updates.verification: 49 exact English-name + ID matches in Wowhead English/Spanish, Jade same-name cross-locale, market-placeholder ID 227855 tied to separately verified recipe 51382/spell 461692, and market-placeholder ID 252948 confirmed by the Forever English/Spanish item records.
updates.caveat: 100% refers to 1212 current market recipe products and materials only. Other game items and UI text may still be untranslated; Forever client availability not confirmed.
